description: Trigger evals for dv:ticket (file a Linear ticket in the agreed format from a rough request). Grooming an existing ticket moved to dv:groom in 0.11.0, so grooming requests are near-misses here. Hard near-misses in no_trigger: grooming, sizing or splitting an existing ticket (dv:groom), doing the work a ticket describes, reading a ticket's status, GitHub issues and PRs, a handoff (dv:handoff) and a plan critique (dv:critique). See tooling/evals/README.md.
